column1: # HCL (Terraform and friends). A definition is a labelled block at the top level of the file, or an
# entry of a top-level locals block. Names follow Terraform's own addresses, which keeps a resource
# and a variable of the same name apart:
#   module "n" -> module.n (package)      provider "p" -> provider.p, or provider.p.<alias> (package)
#   any other labelled block (check, include, dependency, source, job) -> keyword.labels (class)
# Not definitions: blocks with no label (terraform, locals, build, moved, import), blocks nested in
# another block (ingress, provisioner, lifecycle, backend, dynamic, group, task), top-level
# attributes (inputs = ..., the values in a .tfvars file), and anything inside a heredoc or comment.
